steps.npc: Redbeard Frank ye say? He be outside. Says he likes the feel of the wind on his cheeks.

options.text: Are you going to sit there all day?

steps.player: Are you going to sit there all day?

steps.npc: Aye, I am. I canna walk, ye see.
Arrr, I 'ave only the one leg! I lost its twin when my last ship went down.

steps.player: But I can see both your legs!

steps.npc: Nay, young [laddie/lassie], this be a false leg. For years I had me a sturdy wooden peg-leg, but now I wear this dainty little feller.
Yon peg-leg kept getting stuck in the floorboards.
Perhaps a [bright young laddie/bonnie young lassie] like yerself would like to help me? I be needing another ship to go a-hunting my enemy.

steps.text: If the player owns the ship used during Dragon Slayer:

steps.player: Well, I do have a ship that I'm not using. It's the Lady Lumbridge.

steps.npc: Arrr! That ship be known to me, and a fine lass she is.
So would ye be kind enough to let me take her out to sea?

steps.player: I had to pay 2000 gp for that ship. Have you got that much?

steps.text: If the player does not own the ship used during Dragon Slayer:

steps.player: Hmmm. And can you afford another ship?

steps.npc: Nay, I have nary a penny to my name. All my worldly goods went down with me old ship.

steps.player: So you're actually asking me to give you a free ship.

steps.npc: Arrr! Would ye be so kind?

steps.player: Do you have anything for trade?

steps.npc: Nothin' at the moment, but then again the Customs Agents are on the warpath right now.

standard-dialogue-taking-ahab-s-beer.npc: Oi matey, leave my beer alone!

standard-dialogue-casting-telegrab-on-ah.npc: Oi matey, no casting spells on my beer!
